name: diagnostic-logmask
description: DIAGNOSTIC BUILD, NOT FOR DRIVING - forces the global trace mask that gates `Log_msg` (0x02742558), so the ~5900 call sites that go through it run to completion instead of returning at the gate. The mask lives at 0x036d42a8, past the end of the image - BSS, zero at boot - and only ten vtable-exposed `SetTrace` wrappers reach the one instruction that writes it. On its own it produces no output: `Log_msg` then calls 0x010346d0, the sink, which the vendor shipped as `li r3,0 ; blr`. Pair it with `diagnostic-logsink` (builds/diagnostic-logging.json), never with `diagnostic-logging`, which repoints the same sink at `Log_msg` so the two call each other. NAV only; the other builds need their own addresses checked.
summary: forces the global trace mask — **necessary but not sufficient**, see below

patches.why: GetLogMask() -> `li r3,-1 ; blr`. Returns an all-ones mask, so the `(mask & level) == 0` test in Log_msg never short-circuits. Same idiom as the IsAUXSRCAvailable patch: overwrite the prologue with a constant return, no code cave, trivially reversible.
